attributes.name: Druva - Burst of Administrative Changes
attributes.description: Detects an administrator performing a high volume of Druva administrative changes within a short period. A burst of privileged activity can indicate automation misuse, compromised credentials, or malicious configuration tampering.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator performing a high volume of Druva administrative changes within a short period. A burst of privileged activity can indicate automation misuse, compromised credentials, or malicious configuration tampering.

attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and not druva.event_type:"Admin Login"
